features: Laundry Room Rug Size: This long laundry rug measures 20"x48", great size to cover both the laundry room washer and dryer area. This farmhouse laundry room rugs decor runner rug looks very nice and adds an elegant touch in other areas of the home other than kitchen or laundry.

Comfy Laundry Rug Runner Thickness: Pauwer padded kitchen runner rugs are made with quality and functionality, the 4.5mm cushioned rubber foam runner rugs can give you padding and very soft to stand on, also the low profile design make it perfect to fit under the door.

Durable Non Slip Laundry Rug: This large laundry area rug for floor is very durable and holds up well in high traffic areas. Heavy duty non slip runner rugs with rubber backing makes this laundry mat runner stay in place and doesn't slide around under its weight.

Waterproof Kitchen Runner Rugs: Constructed With waterproof stain resistant surface, this rug for laundry room is very easy to wipe up if you spilled something on it, easy to sweep or vacuum clean. Minimal Effort. Maximum Style.

Versatile Use: The non slip runner rug is very comfy and durable, which can be perfectly matched with towels and other laundry room decorations and accessories. Great floor mat carpet rug runner for kitchen floor in front of sink, laundry room in front washer or dryer, door entrance, hallway, wash room, bathroom floor beside the tub, garage.
